note: Original voices made with ElevenLabs Voice Design (eleven_ttv_v3), styled after a 90s NYC hacker / hippie character. No cloning. API key is NOT stored here; use ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

voices.name: Gibson Cereal A
voices.summary: Closest overall: mid-high nasal rasp, laid-back drawl with wide pitch swings and quick bursts (~169 Hz median, 16 st range)

voices.name: Gibson Cereal B
voices.summary: Raspiest and most manic: brighter, choppier stop-start bursts (~185 Hz, 15 st)

voices.name: Gibson Cereal C
voices.summary: Mellowest: a bit lower and warmer, smoother stoner drawl (~152 Hz, 13 st)

voices.name: Gibson Cereal C2
voices.summary: Remix of C, closest to reference: ~0.6 st higher, punchier (shorter vowels, more quick pauses), raspier, thinner/brighter (155 Hz, 14.3 st, 5.0 syl/s, 16.6 pauses/min, HNR 9.0)

voices.name: Gibson Cereal C3
voices.summary: Subtle remix of C, keeps C's timbre: wider pitch swings, more pauses, a bit raspier (147 Hz, 14.9 st, 5.1 syl/s, 13.5 pauses/min, HNR 9.1)

voices.name: Gibson Cereal Y1
voices.summary: Youthful remix of C, closest to reference: 168 Hz median, 13.6 st range, smoother (HNR 10.7 dB), relaxed pace

voices.name: Gibson Cereal Y2
voices.summary: Youthful remix of C, a touch higher and quicker: 177 Hz, 12.8 st, smoother (HNR 10.6 dB)

picked: Gibson Cereal C was "almost right"; C2/C3 rejected (too old/gravelly); Y1/Y2 are youthful remixes of C (2026-10-06)

reference_prosody.source: analysis only of natural-speech lines in a public clip compilation (reading/broadcast section, other characters excluded); audio deleted, never uploaded
